visual_elements.description: Circular positional-encoding 'clock' diagram. Pale-yellow filled circle (center ≈ 57% x / 50% y of slide, diameter ≈ 33% of slide width) divided into 12 equal 30° sectors by 12 thin red radial spokes from center to rim. Dashed red horizontal and vertical axis lines pass through the center and extend across the slide (horizontal line runs through Word 6 and Word 0; vertical line runs through Word 3 and Word 9). Twelve small light-green rounded rectangles sit just outside the rim at 30° intervals, each rotated so its long side is tangent to the circle, labeled in green bold italic text: Word 0 at 3 o'clock (0°), Word 1 (30°), Word 2 (60°), Word 3 at 12 o'clock (90°, text vertical), Word 4 (120°), Word 5 (150°), Word 6 at 9 o'clock (180°), Word 7 (210°), Word 8 (240°), Word 9 at 6 o'clock (270°, text vertical), Word 10 (300°), Word 11 (330°) — i.e., indices increase counterclockwise. Thin orange curved arcs with small orange arrowheads connect each word position to the next counterclockwise (Word 0 → Word 1 → … → Word 11 → Word 0), each arc annotated with a bold red '+ω' label (≈10 labels visible; the remainder appear occluded by the word boxes). A black mouse-pointer cursor (video artifact) overlaps the Word 2 box.
Pale-yellow rectangular formula box with three left-aligned lines: 'Sin(ω t)' (blue bold), 'Cos(ω t)' (blue bold), 't=0,1,2,3,....' (green).

White rectangle with ~2px red border and three centered lines: 'Using smaller ω value, allow' / 'representation of longer sequences' (blue bold, with the single word 'smaller' carrying a yellow highlight) and '(practically use  ω = 1/10000)' (red).
Slide-number badge: yellow circle with a dark navy ring containing the number '29' in dark text.
Solid black horizontal bar across the very bottom of the frame (video letterbox artifact, not designed slide content).

imagery: Black mouse-pointer cursor resting on/near the Word 2 box at upper right of the circle — a screen-recording artifact, not designed slide content. No photographs or illustrations otherwise; all graphics are vector shapes (circle, spokes, arcs, boxes, badge).
typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Verdana-like). Title: bold, largest text on slide (~28-32pt), red, three lines with the third line ('as angles') indented right. Formula-box lines: bold ~18pt, blue for Sin/Cos, green for the t-values. Word labels: bold italic ~12pt green. '+ω' arc labels: bold red ~14pt. Note-box text: bold ~14pt, centered, blue with yellow-highlighted word and a red third line. Slide number: plain ~14pt dark text in a yellow circle.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built — no partial bullet reveal or mid-build elements. A static mouse cursor near Word 2 indicates this is a frame from a screen recording.
recreation_brief:
1. Canvas: create a 13.33in × 7.5in (16:9) slide with a solid light-gray background #E8E8E8; all percentages below are measured from the slide's left/top edges and inch values assume this canvas.
2. Title (top-left): text box with left edge at 3% (0.4in), top at 9% (0.7in), width 30% (4.0in), height 14% (1.05in); three left-aligned lines in Arial bold 30pt red #CC0000: 'Sequence of 12 words' / 'Positions are defined' / 'as angles', with line 3 indented ≈0.4in to the right of lines 1-2.
3. Slide-number badge (top-right): circle centered at 92.5% x / 13% y, diameter 0.45in; fill yellow #FFFF00, outline dark navy #333399 (~2pt); centered plain black #000000 text '29' at ~14pt.
4. Main circle (center-right): circle centered at 57% x / 50% y (7.6in, 3.75in), diameter 33% of slide width (≈4.4in); fill pale yellow #FFFFCC, no outline (none specified in source).
5. Spokes: 12 thin lines in light red #FF8080 from the circle's center to its rim at 30° intervals (0°, 30°, 60°, 90°, 120°, 150°, 180°, 210°, 240°, 270°, 300°, 330° counterclockwise from 3 o'clock), coinciding with the 12 word-position angles and dividing the circle into 12 equal 30° sectors.
6. Dashed axes: two dashed red #FF0000 lines through the circle center — a horizontal line at y = 50% spanning the full slide width (passing through the Word 6 and Word 0 positions) and a vertical line at x = 57% spanning the full slide height (passing through the Word 3 and Word 9 positions).
7. Word boxes (12): rounded rectangles 0.9in × 0.35in, fill light green #CCFFCC, thin outline #008000 (outline color not specified in source); centered text 'Word 0' through 'Word 11' in green #008000 bold italic ~12pt. Place each box just outside the rim, centered on its angle, rotated so its long side is tangent to the circle: Word 0 at 0° (3 o'clock, horizontal), Word 1 at 30°, Word 2 at 60°, Word 3 at 90° (12 o'clock, vertical), Word 4 at 120°, Word 5 at 150°, Word 6 at 180° (9 o'clock, horizontal), Word 7 at 210°, Word 8 at 240°, Word 9 at 270° (6 o'clock, vertical), Word 10 at 300°, Word 11 at 330° — angles measured counterclockwise from 3 o'clock.
8. Arcs (12): thin curved arcs in orange #FF6600 with small orange arrowheads, each following the circle's curvature counterclockwise from one word box to the next: Word 0→Word 1, Word 1→Word 2, …, Word 10→Word 11, Word 11→Word 0.
9. Arc labels (12): text '+ω' in bold red #FF0000 ~14pt placed beside each of the 12 arcs (design intent is one label per arc; in the source frame ≈10 are visible and ≈2 are occluded by word boxes — recreate all 12).
10. Formula box (middle-left): rectangle with left edge at 8% (1.1in), top at 31% (2.3in), width 14% (1.9in), height 14% (1.05in); fill pale yellow #FFFFCC; three left-aligned bold ~18pt lines: 'Sin(ω t)' and 'Cos(ω t)' in blue #0000CC, then 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green #008000.
11. Note box (bottom-left): rectangle with left edge at 6% (0.8in), top at 71% (5.3in), width 31% (4.1in), height 23% (1.75in); fill white #FFFFFF, border red #CC0000 ~2pt; three centered bold ~14pt lines: 'Using smaller ω value, allow' and 'representation of longer sequences' in blue #0000CC with the single word 'smaller' highlighted yellow #FFFF00, then '(practically use  ω = 1/10000)' in red #CC0000 (preserve the double space after 'use').
12. Exclusions: do not draw the black mouse-pointer cursor near the Word 2 box or the solid black strip along the bottom edge (0-100% width, 96-100% height) — both are screen-recording/letterbox artifacts, not slide content; add the black strip only if the goal is to mimic the video frame exactly.
